about.title: About
about.subtitle: Your trusted AI tools directory for civil engineering
about.metaDesc: Learn about TumuAI.net: AI tools directory and review platform for civil engineers. We continuously curate, categorize and update quality tools.
about.badge: AI Tools Navigation & Reviews for Civil Engineers
about.intro: We organize quality tools scattered across the internet into an easy-to-find, easy-to-use, and continuously updated library. Spend your time on engineering, not searching.
about.missionDesc: Help every civil engineer find and use practical tools faster: not just listing, but focusing on organization, clarity, and sustainable updates.
about.missionPoint1: Organize tools by engineering scenarios: structural, BIM, construction, cost estimation, project management...
about.missionPoint2: Reduce information noise: provide clearer descriptions, tags, and categories
about.missionPoint3: Make contribution easier: submit tools, provide feedback, open-source collaboration
about.value1Desc: Focused on civil engineering, organizing tools by workflow and scenario to reduce information noise.
about.value2Desc: Starting from real engineer needs, prioritizing usability, accessibility, and search efficiency.
about.value3Desc: Ensuring clear information, working links, reasonable categorization, and continuous corrections.
about.value4Desc: Following AI advances and new tools, bringing you the latest effective solutions.
about.team1Desc: Continuously optimizing navigation, search, filtering, and submission experience based on engineer workflows.
about.team2Desc: Maintaining data structure and categorization, driving performance optimization for faster and more accurate results.
about.team3Desc: Following industry tools and use cases, producing engineering-focused recommendations and comparisons.
about.workflow1Desc: Enter the website and description, we'll help identify logo, category, and details.
about.workflow2Desc: Check availability and information completeness to ensure clear and usable listings.
about.workflow3Desc: After approval, tools appear in the Tools Center for browsing, searching, and filtering.
about.workflow4Desc: Based on feedback, continuously correct information, add tags and categories, keep the library alive.
about.criteria1p2: Category and pricing info is complete
about.criteria3p1: Page is accessible, features can be tested
about.criteria3p3: No obviously broken or redirecting links
about.criteria4p2: Authors welcome to provide better materials
about.criteria4p3: Comparison info will be continuously improved
about.faq1Q: How do I submit a new tool?
about.faq1A: Click 'Submit Tool', enter the website URL and description. You can also add category, feature tags, and logo - we'll refine the information during review.
about.faq2Q: Why do some tool logos not display?
about.faq2A: Some websites restrict icon access or change paths. We provide fallback icons that don't affect usage; you can also upload a more stable logo when submitting.
about.faq3Q: What if I find incorrect info or broken links?
about.faq3A: You can submit feedback via email or GitHub, we continuously correct and update.
about.faq4A: Absolutely: submit tools, report issues, add categories and tags, or submit PRs on GitHub - all are very welcome.
about.storySubtitle: Starting from 'finding tools takes too much time'
about.storyP1: TumuAI.net was born from a practical pain point: AI tools are everywhere, but the ones engineers really need are often buried in search results and information noise.
about.storyP2: We want to build a 'tool map' closer to engineering scenarios: organizing tools by professional domains and workflows so you spend less time finding the right tool.
about.storyP3: This isn't a one-time effort but continuous collaboration. Tools update, URLs change, features evolve - so we prioritize 'sustainable updates' and 'community feedback'.
about.workflowSubtitle: Making submission, review, and updates smoother
about.criteriaSubtitle: Goal: reliable info, scenario relevance, sustainable updates
about.teamSubtitle: Maintained by engineers, developers, and content editors
about.privacySubtitle: We only collect information necessary for providing services, minimizing intrusion.
about.privacyCollect1: Account info: email (for login/verification), public nickname and avatar (if you provide).
about.privacyCollect2: Usage data: favorites, comments, tool submissions - data related to your active operations.
about.privacyCollect3: Basic logs: for troubleshooting and ensuring service stability (not sold to third parties).
about.privacyUse1: Provide core features: login, favorites, comments, submission and review processes.
about.privacyUse2: Improve experience: optimize search/filtering, fix bugs, enhance performance.
about.privacyStorageDesc: We use third-party infrastructure (e.g., databases/object storage) to host necessary data. External tool websites are governed by their own privacy policies and terms.
about.privacyContactDesc: For account deletion or data export, contact us via WeChat: fuyesq168
about.privacyNote: Note: This is a summary version, will be continuously improved.
about.termsSubtitle: Before using, we recommend reviewing these key points.
about.termsDisclaimer1: TumuAI.net provides tool navigation and information aggregation, without guaranteeing third-party tool functionality, compliance, or availability.
about.termsDisclaimer2: Risks and costs from accessing third-party websites/services are borne by users.
about.termsContent1: When submitting tools/comments, ensure information is authentic, legal, and non-infringing.
about.termsContent2: We reserve the right to edit, remove, or reject submitted content (e.g., broken links, misleading info, infringement, or inappropriate content).
about.termsUpdateDesc: We may adjust terms based on feature updates and compliance requirements, updating this page accordingly.
about.contactSubtitle: Suggestions, collaborations, or feedback? Contact us via WeChat or submit Issues/PRs on GitHub.
about.feedbackDesc: Found broken links, inaccurate descriptions, or wrong categories? Submit feedback and we'll continuously correct.
about.prDesc: You can also submit PRs directly on GitHub to collaborate on categories, copy, and feature improvements.
about.collabDesc: If you're a tool author or team, contact us: we can work together to improve descriptions and showcase use cases.
about.missionText: To help civil engineers discover and adopt AI tools that improve productivity and design quality.
about.visionText: To become the go-to platform for civil engineers seeking AI-powered solutions.
